definitions.explanation: a vehicle or wheeled device used to move goods, materials, or equipment from one place to another

examples.japanese: {運搬車|うんぱんしゃ}で{荷物|にもつ}を{運|はこ}ぶ。
examples.english: To carry luggage with a transport cart.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}では{電動|でんどう}{運搬車|うんぱんしゃ}が{使|つか}われている。
examples.english: Electric transport vehicles are used in the factory.

examples.japanese: {建設|けんせつ}{現場|げんば}で{資材|しざい}を{運|はこ}ぶために{大型|おおがた}の{運搬車|うんぱんしゃ}が{何台|なんだい}も{出入|でい}りしている。
examples.english: Several large transport vehicles are going in and out of the construction site to carry materials.

notes:
A compound of {運搬|うんぱん} (transport, conveyance) and {車|しゃ} (vehicle). Can refer to anything from small hand carts to large industrial vehicles, depending on context. Most commonly used in industrial, construction, and logistics settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電動|でんどう}{運搬車|うんぱんしゃ}: electric transport vehicle
- {手押|てお}し{運搬車|うんぱんしゃ}: push cart
- {運搬車|うんぱんしゃ}を{操作|そうさ}する: to operate a transport vehicle
- {荷物|にもつ}{運搬車|うんぱんしゃ}: luggage carrier

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {台車|だいしゃ}: hand cart, dolly — a simple wheeled platform for moving goods
- トラック: truck — a motor vehicle for transporting goods on roads
- フォークリフト: forklift — a powered industrial truck for lifting and moving pallets
